en: Black‑and‑white view of a European historic city square with a large monument and fountain in the center, surrounded by multi‑story buildings with steep tiled roofs and arcades at street level. Market stalls with umbrellas and pedestrians fill the square. In the background on a hill stands a fortified wall with a prominent clock tower (the Uhrturm). The overall look is early‑20th‑century urban Europe.
